jobs.title: Product Management Director - 11581
jobs.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
 
Why join Coupa?
Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other. 
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa. 


The Impact of a Product Management Director at Coupa: 
Coupa is scaling one of the world’s largest B2B supplier networks, connecting millions of buyers and suppliers globally through community-generated AI and trillions of dollars in direct and indirect spend data. This role sits at the heart of Coupa’s next phase of growth. You will directly shape the future of the Coupa Network by leading AI-forward innovation that scales supplier success, buyer trust, intelligent automation, and monetization into a durable, two-sided marketplace strategy.
Join our fast-paced Supplier Network team that is building the future of the Coupa Network. As a senior product leader, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for AI-powered features that transform how buyers and suppliers discover, connect, transact, and build trust at scale—driving measurable network liquidity, revenue growth, and platform differentiation in the spend management ecosystem.

What You’ll Do 
- Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for aspects of our Supplier Network, with a strong emphasis on AI-forward capabilities such as intelligent buyer-supplier matching, predictive risk and fraud detection, generative AI for onboarding and insights, autonomous workflows, and adaptive trust/identity verification.

- Define and scale two-sided growth loops that increase buyer demand, supplier participation, transaction velocity, and network effects while maintaining marketplace integrity and buyer trust.

- Lead product strategy for supplier business, including subscriptions, premium visibility, marketplace access, sourcing events, APIs, and new AI-powered premium services.

- Partner deeply with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, Data Science, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver high-impact features from concept to launch and iteration.

- Drive product-led growth (PLG) motions tailored to enterprise procurement workflows, balancing speed with long-term platform health and second-order network effects.

- Engage directly with customers and prospects to validate needs, gather insights, and shape differentiating solutions in supplier profiles, risk, trust, and identity management.

- Define north-star metrics and success frameworks focused on network liquidity, activation rates, monetization, retention, and AI-driven business outcomes

- Monitor emerging trends in AI, two-sided marketplaces, trust/identity providers, and spend management to keep Coupa at the forefront of innovation.
What You Will Bring to Coupa 
- 8+ years of product management experience, with senior leadership ownership of growth, monetization, marketplace, or network products in B2B SaaS companies

- Proven experience scaling two-sided buyer and supplier networks (or equivalent marketplaces/platforms) with a track record of driving meaningful revenue and adoption

- Strong intuition for AI/ML applications in enterprise workflows (e.g., predictive analytics, generative AI, intelligent automation, or trust/identity systems).

- Experience operating in fast-paced, matrixed organizations with the ability to influence across functions and executives.

- Data-driven decision-making skills, excellent communication, and a builder mindset comfortable with ambiguity and high accountability.

Preferred

- Direct experience at spend management platforms like Coupa or similar (e.g., procurement, payables, or supplier risk solutions).

- Background with trust and identity providers or supplier verification companies such as Relish or Trustpair (vendor fraud prevention, bank account validation, and identity verification) in B2B.

- Passion for AI innovation and its ability to transform B2B commerce and supplier ecosystems.

- Deep understanding of procurement, spend management, supplier lifecycle, risk management, or supplier information management.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
 
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
 
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.

The Impact of a Senior Product Manager, Coupa AI Document Intelligence at Coupa: 
We are on a mission to automate how businesses transact. As the Senior Product Manager for AI Products, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Coupa’s next-generation AI capabilities. You will provide product leadership to our Document Intelligence AI Data Capture area, expand on our highly successful proprietary T-LLM predictive models and continue to bring state-of-the-art in machine learning.
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of product innovation, AI/ML strategy, and enterprise workflow transformation. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, data science, design, and go-to-market teams to turn customer needs and AI advancements into tangible product value. You will play a key role in building intelligent, autonomous capabilities that streamline procurement and finance processes—leveraging Coupa’s platform, proprietary data, and community intelligence in a secure and scalable way.

What You’ll Do 
- Own and execute the product vision Coupa’s Document Intelligence AI products and capabilities, with a focus on building intelligent, autonomous software that enhance procurement, sourcing, and spend workflows

- Embed into Data Science Research and AI Platform product teams - we work within the product delivery model and collaborate daily, continuously validate hypotheses, and iterate.

- Work with high-caliber AI talent that builds proprietary AI technology, leverage top-tier research infrastructure, including clusters of high-end GPUs and large-memory machines, to run ambitious experiments at real-world scale.

- Partner closely with UX research and design teams to craft delightful and reliable AI experiences that are intuitive, context-aware, and action-oriented; engage with customers and customer facing teams to get deep customer insights.

- Translate cutting-edge AI technologies (LLMs, embeddings) into practical, user-friendly product features that drive measurable business outcomes

- Define and monitor product success metrics such as model precision, response relevance, adoption rates, and user satisfaction

- Align and coordinate with cross-functional teams including engineering, GTM, customer success, and product marketing to ensure successful launch and adoption

- Evangelize and advocate internally and externally for complex and sometimes difficult-to-explain technologies

- Drive products through all stages of design, building, and long-term adoption

- Ruthless prioritization of different organizational priorities to achieve maximum impact

- Continuously improve how we deliver digital products
What You Will Bring to Coupa 
- 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML, or enterprise automation building or managing AI/ML or AI products, with a strong understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and agentic AI design.

- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements and user-centric experiences

- A track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams — especially data science, ML engineering, and UX design — to deliver AI-powered features at scale

- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify high-impact use cases and prioritize AI capabilities that drive real business value

- Curiosity and adaptability to stay ahead in a fast-evolving AI landscape, proactively learning about emerging models, tooling, and design patterns

- Excellent communication and storytelling skills — both to align internal teams and to articulate product value to stakeholders

- Experience with agile principles, iterative development, and launching experimental or MVP AI capabilities

- Deep empathy for end users and a passion for crafting intelligent, intuitive, and trustworthy AI interactions

- Have an innovative and entrepreneurial mindset, but a “willingness to do the dirty work” attitude

- Experience working cross-functionally in SaaS organizations with product management teams, structuring and analyzing data to yield interpretable, actionable insights.

- Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority

jobs.description:

Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other. 
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa. 

What You’ll Do 
- Lead the Expenses teams product design and requirements across complex, cross-functional initiatives, partnering closely with Engineering, UX, Platform, and Success teams to align on scope, dependencies, and delivery approach.

- Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give internal teams (Product, Growth, Leadership) clear visibility into product adoption, usage, and customer health.

- Act as a go-to subject matter expert for customer escalations, partnering with Support, Services, and Engineering to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

- Translate customer feedback and usage data into clear product requirements and prioritization recommendations.

- Conduct competitive market analysis and continually assess the product's competitive position domestically and internationally.

- Support and help scale internal and external enablement (webinars, documentation, training) so Support, Services, and Customer Success teams can operate more self-sufficiently.

- Represent the product in customer-facing settings, including advisory boards, escalation calls, and adoption reviews.
What You Will Bring to Coupa 
- 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments with a proven track record of building buyer-facing products and consumer-grade UX

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous requirements through to delivery, coordinating effectively across Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.

- Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience building or using dashboards/reporting tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau) to drive product and business decisions.

- A track record of resolving complex customer issues and turning escalations into durable product or process improvements.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

- A collaborative, "roll up your sleeves" mindset paired with sound judgment on when to lead and when to support.

- Comfort operating with incomplete information and adapting quickly as priorities shift.

Preferred Skills:

- Experience in Expense Management, Corporate Cards, or related Finance/Procurement domains.

- Familiarity with SQL and comfort querying data directly to answer product questions.

- Experience working with or presenting to customer advisory boards or executive audiences.

- Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or PeopleSoft.

- BA/BS technical degree preferred; MBA is a plus, or equivalent work experience.

This role is fully remote within the US
